description: The pie chart presents the distribution of problems across mathematics topics and educational levels in the MathOdyssey/Odyssey Math dataset, showing 11 slices in total with labels and percentages annotated outside the wedges via leader lines and no separate legend. The slices are: Algebra – University-level (medium gray) at 21.19% (82); Algebra – High School (pink) at 17.83% (69); Pre-Calculus – High School (brown) at 14.21% (55); Combinatorics – Olympiad-level (light green) at 9.56% (37); Geometry – Olympiad-level (light orange) at 6.46% (25); Linear Algebra and Abstract Algebra – University-level (magenta) at 6.46% (25); Calculus and Analysis – University-level (dark gray) at 6.20% (24); Probability – University-level (cyan) at 5.43% (21); Statistics – University-level (light teal) at 4.39% (17); Differential Equations – University-level (yellow-green) at 3.62% (14); and Geometry – High School (light purple) at 3.62% (14). No slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized, and the segments do not appear strictly ordered by size around the circle.
